parts.html: A 52 m² apartment where we went through the whole process: an interior design project with 3D visualization, technical drawings, custom furniture, turnkey renovation, and decorating. The project included a kitchen-living room, a bedroom with a workspace by the window, walk-in closets, an entrance hall, and a bathroom. The gallery shows photorealistic visualizations.

The kitchen and living room are one space. The kitchen runs along the wall: upper cabinets in light veneer, tall columns with white high-gloss fronts for built-in appliances, and a backsplash of dark veined stone. A breakfast bar on a transparent support extends from the kitchen and separates the work area from the sofa.

Opposite the sofa is a wall of white vertical slats with a TV and a floating media unit with black fronts. A concealed LED strip runs along the edge of the ceiling bulkhead, and above the sofa is a wall light made of two rings with perimeter lighting.

The lower half of the wall behind the bed is covered with light gray panels; above them are white handleless cabinets across the full width, with a narrow open niche and lighting. Above the bedside table hang two brass-colored ring pendants. By the window we set up a workspace: a wooden desktop with lit shelves above it and a tall white cabinet beside it.

In the hallway, one side is taken up by a floor-to-ceiling wardrobe in wood veneer with a long black profile handle; on the other side are flush-mounted doors in the wall color. The floors in the rooms are oak-look.

The bathroom is finished in large-format light marble-look tile. The vanity is dark wood, with a mirror with rounded corners and lighting above it. It has a bathtub and a shower behind a glass screen, and next to the wall-hung toilet stands a wooden unit with lit shelves at the top and a closed cabinet below.

The kitchen, built-in cabinets, shelves, and storage systems were designed together with the interior to fit the rooms and made to order (more on the custom furniture page). Before work began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering the renovation, finishing materials, furniture, and appliances, so the budget was known in advance.
